newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLL - Metsa Serla Jan-June seen higher.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Metsa Serla Jan-June seen higher.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 269 million markka median forecast for forest industry group Metsa-Serla Oy's six-month profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Metsa-Serla's results are due on August 7 at 0800/0500 GMT.
In January-June 1996, Metsa-Serla had a proforma 223 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax, a company executive told Reuters by telephone. It reported by tertial in 1996.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, eleven of the analysts polled gave a median forecast of 694 million markka (mean 682 million) in a 412-837 million markka range.

Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg, Carnegie Securities, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Den Danske Bank, Enskilda Securities, Evli Securities, Goldman Sachs, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Bank, Opstock.
